title: ChartRefreshPlan
description: Runtime refresh policy for a chart artifact.

mode.description: Phase 1A supports snapshot and poll. SSE/external refresh modes are deferred.

intervalSeconds.description: Polling interval in seconds when mode=poll.

visibleOnly.description: Whether the UI should poll only while the chart is visible.

staleAfterSeconds.description: Seconds after the last successful refresh before data is considered stale.

maxConsecutiveFailures.description: Consecutive refresh failures before the UI shows an error state.
